exit_line.definition: A prepared sentence that ends a conversation politely while leaving the door open for another meeting.
exit_line.example: It was really nice meeting you — see you around.

mia_appeal_to_authority.definition: The replacing of a reason with the title or the status of the person who offers it.
mia_appeal_to_authority.example: The chief engineer says it is safe was an appeal to authority, because no evidence was shown.

saturated_fat.definition: The saturated fats, which are the part of the fat that matters most for blood cholesterol.
saturated_fat.example: It has 11 g of saturates, which is over half the daily reference.

spec_judgement.definition: The ability to form an opinion from experience and to defend it.
spec_judgement.example: The judgement to stop the line is part of what the company pays for.

tap.definition: The small handle or knob that turns the water on and off.
tap.example: Turn the tap off when you finish washing.
